sources.title: Pantheon Build Guide: STARDUST & STEEL: The Ascension of Man

passive.name: Mortal Will
passive.text: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

spells.name: Comet Spear
spells.text: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

spells.name: Shield Vault
spells.text: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

spells.name: Aegis Assault
spells.text: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

spells.name: Grand Starfall
spells.text: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

axis.value: Pantheon pushes the wave and vanishes to pressure other lanes.

winCondition.value: Pantheon turns lane pressure into kills during ganks and pressure across the map with R.

bait.why: Pantheon is easier to damage after E is spent because he can no longer use it to veto a high-damage ability.
